leftovers.name: Leftovers
leftovers.description: Restores 1/16 of max HP each turn.

choice_band.name: Choice Band
choice_band.description: Boosts Attack by 50% but locks into one move.

choice_specs.name: Choice Specs
choice_specs.description: Boosts Sp.Atk by 50% but locks into one move.

focus_sash.name: Focus Sash
focus_sash.description: Survives a one-hit KO with 1 HP if at full health. Single use.

life_orb.name: Life Orb
life_orb.description: Boosts damage by 30% but takes 10% recoil each attack.

shell_bell.name: Shell Bell
shell_bell.description: Heals 1/8 of damage dealt to opponent.

quick_claw.name: Quick Claw
quick_claw.description: 20% chance to move first regardless of Speed.

kings_rock.name: Kings Rock
kings_rock.description: 10% chance to cause flinching on any damaging move.

sitrus_berry.name: Sitrus Berry
sitrus_berry.description: Restores 25% HP when HP drops below 50%. Single use.

oran_berry.name: Oran Berry
oran_berry.description: Restores 10 HP when HP drops below 50%. Single use.

lum_berry.name: Lum Berry
lum_berry.description: Cures any status condition. Single use.

leppa_berry.name: Leppa Berry
leppa_berry.description: Restores 10 PP to a depleted move. Single use.
